questions.question: Rajasthan, famous for its forts, palaces, and desert landscapes, has branded itself as the “Land of Kings.” The Rajasthan Tourism Department has been actively using digital storytelling to attract domestic and international tourists by highlighting its unique heritage and royal culture. Content Strategy: Visual Content: Immersive drone videos of forts, palaces, desert festivals, and camel safaris. Storytelling: Campaigns like “Padharo Mhare Des” that focus on hospitality, valor, and cultural pride. User-Generated Content (UGC): Encouraging travelers to post pictures of their desert camping experiences and folk dance nights with hashtags like #Royal Rajasthan. Educational Content: Blogs and You Tube series about Rajasthani cuisine, history of Rajput kings, and handicrafts. Multilingual Campaigns: Targeting European and Asian audiences through translations in German, French, and Japanese. Questions for Analysis: (a) How does Rajasthan Tourism use content marketing to preserve cultural heritage while promoting tourism? (b) Discuss the impact of storytelling in positioning Rajasthan as a premium heritage destination. (c) How can UGC campaigns enhance Rajasthan’s visibility in international markets? (d) What challenges might arise in balancing heritage conservation with mass tourism promotion? (e) Suggest innovative digital content strategies (like VR palace tours or AR-based apps) to attract younger global audiences. ( An, CO2, 5)

questions.question: Ramaraj Mundukal, a trusted name in traditional men’s wear (especially dhotis/mundus), has been serving South Indian customers for decades. Traditionally, sales relied on word-of-mouth, retail stores, and festival shopping seasons. With changing lifestyles and competition from branded apparel like Peter England, Ramraj Cotton shifted to digital and social media marketing to reach both traditional and modern audiences. Digital & Social Media Strategies: Social media presence (Facebook, Instagram, You Tube) promoting mundus, shirts, innerwear, and combos with catchy visuals. Festive campaigns: Onam, Pongal, Vishu, and weddings promoted through reels, short videos, and celebrity endorsements. Storytelling ads: Campaigns like “Tradition with Pride” highlight cultural identity, purity of cotton, and craftsmanship.Influencer & celebrity marketing: Popular actors (like Vijay Sethupathi, Vishal, etc.) featured in digital ads to connect with youth. Engaging younger audiences: Modern styled mundus, combo packs, and styling reels showing how traditional attire can blend with contemporary fashion.
